Name: Unlock Best Friend's Door
Author: oatgh2222
Description:
🔑 Unlock BFF Houses Door[b]Unlock BFF Houses Door[/b] is a Stardew Valley mod that allows trusted NPC friends to grant the player access to their homes when a strong bond is formed.
When your friendship with an NPC reaches [b]8 or more hearts[/b], they will automatically give you a key to their house. From that point on, you can enter their home freely, regardless of opening hours.
This mod focuses on [b]immersion, realism, and roleplay consistency[/b], reinforcing the idea that true friends should trust you enough to let you in.
[line]✅ Main Features[list]
[*]🔐 NPCs grant a house key when friendship reaches 8+ hearts
[*]🏠 Full access to their home at any time
[*]🎯 Automatically integrates with vanilla door logic
[*]💾 Persistent save-based data using [code]modData[/code]
[*]🤝 Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
[*]🧠 Intelligent house detection (no hardcoded locations)
[*]🧩 Compatible with custom NPCs from other mods
[*]⚙ Clean and optimized Harmony patching
[/list][line]🧭 How It Works[list]
[*]At the start of each in-game day, friendship values are evaluated.
[*]If the player has 8 or more hearts with an NPC, the key is automatically granted.
[*]The door lock logic is overridden via Harmony, allowing entry if the player owns the key.
[/list]There is no need for additional items or manual configuration — the system works completely in the background and adapts naturally to the player's progress.
[line]🎮 Gameplay Integration[list]
[*]Keys are granted naturally through friendship progression
[*]No UI clutter or invasive mechanics
[*]Respectful of Stardew's original atmosphere and flow
[*]Seamlessly blends with existing NPC behavior
[/list]The mod simply extends what already feels like a natural evolution of trust.
[line]📦 Installation[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI

[*]Download and extract the mod

[*]Place it inside your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder

[*]Launch the game as usual

[/list][line]🔗 Open Source & Learning ResourceThis project is completely open source and intended to help aspiring modders learn by example.
👉 GitHub Repository:
[url=https://github.com/oatgh2/StardewValley_UnlockBffHousesDoor]https://github.com/oatgh2/StardewValley_UnlockBffHousesDoor[/url]
Feel free to explore, fork, modify and use this project as a base for your own creations.
[line]🛠 Technical Highlights[list]
[*]Written in C# with .NET 6
[*]Uses SMAPI + Harmony for precise patching
[*]Modular architecture with event-driven design
[*]Reflection-based auto-registration of systems
[*]Save-safe and multiplayer-aware logic
[/list][line]📷 Suggested ScreenshotsYou may want to include in the Nexus page:
[list]
[*]Attempting to enter an NPC house before 8 hearts (locked)
[*]Same house unlocked after friendship milestone
[*]Console log confirmation from SMAPI
[/list][line]💡 Recommended Use Cases[list]
[*]Roleplay-focused playthroughs
[*]Immersion-based farming sessions
[*]Friendship-centered narratives
[*]Long-term save files with deep NPC interaction
[/list][line]📝 Notes[list]
[*]Keys are managed automatically based on friendship level
[*]If friendship drops below 8 hearts, access may be revoked (optional behavior depending on future updates)
[*]Fully compatible with existing saves
[/list][line]📣 Feedback & SupportIf you'd like to suggest improvements, report bugs or contribute:
You can do so directly via the GitHub repository or by leaving a comment on the Nexus page.
[line]⭐ Final ThoughtsUnlock BFF Houses Door enhances the emotional progression of Stardew Valley, reinforcing the bond between the player and their closest friends while maintaining the spirit of the original game.
Whether you play for immersion, storytelling, or realism, this mod offers a subtle but meaningful experience.
Enjoy your new friendships — and the trust that comes with them.
